description: This file contains unit tests for ADO.NET stream filtering functionality across different database providers (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL) using the Orleans framework. It defines test classes, setup fixtures, and configuration for stream filtering tests.

classes.name: SqlServerAdoNetStreamFilteringTests
classes.description: Test class for SQL Server ADO.NET stream filtering.

classes.name: MySqlAdoNetStreamFilteringTests
classes.description: Test class for MySQL ADO.NET stream filtering.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetStreamFilteringTests
classes.description: Test class for PostgreSQL ADO.NET stream filtering.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamFilteringTests
classes.description: Abstract base class for ADO.NET stream filtering tests, providing setup and configuration for the tests.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Fixture class for setting up the test environment, including database connection and stream provider configuration.

classes.name: TestSiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo with ADO.NET stream provider and stream filter.

classes.name: TestClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans client with ADO.NET stream provider and stream filter.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture asynchronously, setting up the database environment.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes of the test fixture asynchronously.

methods.name: EnsurePreconditionsMet
methods.description: Ensures that the test preconditions are met before running tests.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo or client with stream provider and filter options.

methods.name: IgnoreBadFilter
methods.description: Test method to verify behavior with a bad filter.

methods.name: OnlyEvenItems
methods.description: Test method to verify filtering of only even items.

methods.name: MultipleSubscriptionsDifferentFilterData
methods.description: Test method to verify multiple subscriptions with different filter data.
